t: A no-technology card activity that introduces AI to learners aged 6 and up.
steps: Find Introducing AI on the Model AI Assignments site.
Download the worksheet packet and the card deck.
Print both double-sided and cut out the cards.
Provide legal-size paper in landscape for worksheet pages 3-4.
Provide writing tools, glue, and colored pencils or markers.
Prepare to unpack details in later lessons.
